summary: Two distinct measures are available: ABS domestic business employment (headcount) and IGEA full-time employment including FTEs and contractors. IGEA added nonresponding-studio estimates for FY2025; do not interpret that change as a consistent survey trend.

series.label: IGEA full-time employment incl. contractors
series.industry_scope: Australian game development studios including contracted development and all internal roles; broader publishing distribution, hardware, retail, venues, esports and indirect employment not included as separate sectors.
series.occupation_scope: All roles in covered businesses, including creative, technical and business functions.
series.geography_note: Domestic workers irrespective of citizenship or employer ownership are the comparison target; exact source rules below.
series.worker_status: Source says full-time employees, includes full-time equivalents and contractors. Conversion of every contractor to FTE is not established. Founders/interns/apprentices not separately specified.
series.contractor_treatment: Included in source total; no separate count. Do not label as pure employee headcount or pure FTE.
series.method: Voluntary studio survey, changing respondent pool; no verified full-population expansion for historical series.
series.comparison_note: Financial years ending 30 June. Changing studio samples; no continuous population estimate or index.
series.source_native_term: No. of employees; full time employees*
series.term_translation: Source footnote: includes full-time equivalents and contractors.

series.label: IGEA survey plus studio estimates
series.industry_scope: Australian game development studios including contracted development and all internal roles; broader publishing distribution, hardware, retail, venues, esports and indirect employment not included as separate sectors.
series.occupation_scope: All roles in covered businesses, including creative, technical and business functions.
series.geography_note: Domestic workers irrespective of citizenship or employer ownership are the comparison target; exact source rules below.
series.worker_status: Full-time employees including FTEs and contractors; other statuses unknown.
series.contractor_treatment: Included in total per p1 footnote; no separate count or full conversion specification.
series.method: FY2025 voluntary responses from 141 studios plus third-party estimates for selected nonrespondents (FAQ). Not a demonstrated exhaustive national census.
series.sample_size: 141 usable studio responses; over 600 invited; supplementary estimates for selected nonrespondents.
series.comparison_note: Methodology break from historical survey. Source_native total retained; do not calculate a consistent 2024-25 decline.

series.label: ABS people employed in development businesses
series.industry_scope: Digital game development businesses, own-title and fee-for-service production; all internal roles. Broader hardware, retail, venues and indirect jobs excluded. Other activities within multi-activity business units may remain.
series.occupation_scope: All roles in covered businesses, including creative, technical and business functions.
series.geography_note: Domestic workers irrespective of citizenship or employer ownership are the comparison target; exact source rules below.
series.worker_status: Working proprietors and partners, payroll employees including paid-leave and workers compensation, and contract workers paid through payroll included. Non-salaried directors and volunteers excluded. Apprentices and interns not separately quantified.
series.contractor_treatment: Payroll contract workers included. Payments to self-employed contractors are outside wages and salaries; off-payroll contractor headcount not included as an employee count.
series.method: Census of known digital game development businesses; ABS Business Register plus industry sources. Last pay period ending June. Scope/classification changes require caution across survey years.
series.sample_size: Census of known in-scope businesses; response count not extracted.
series.comparison_note: Headcount snapshots, no 2019 baseline. ABS cautions comparisons to 2015-16 as categories changed; do not join to IGEA.
series.source_native_term: ABS people employed in development businesses
series.term_translation: ABS people employed in development businesses
